<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/firmware/upgrade"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Initiate device firmware upgrade via the existing `upgrade_handler` process of HubOtaServlet.
The request body should directly use the device upgrade array, and the array must and can only contain one device.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}

>
</Heading>
